answers.goal: Does not endorse the LLM switch yet; attributes the failed answers to a stage, measures retrieval apart (recall at the k sent, labelled queries including unanswerable ones, relevance pooled across retrievers), then generation on fixed contexts.

Refuses to confirm the swap without a re-run; adds questions whose answer is in no document with a plain "not found" as expected answer; treats the swap as a release compared on the same questions, per class, after judging newly surfaced passages.
